title: Meet the Minister's standards for mobile telecommunications services
what: Carriers and carriage service providers must comply with standards the Minister determines for mobile services, on matters such as reliability, voice call quality and the time to fix faults.

laws.title: Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999

sources.title: Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999
sources.quote: Compliance (6) A carrier or carriage service provider must comply with a standard determined under subsection (1) of this section.

sources.title: Telecommunications (Consumer Protection and Service Standards) Act 1999
sources.quote: 125B Standards (1) The Minister may, by legislative instrument, determine standards to be complied with by carriers and carriage service providers in relation to any or all of the following matters relating to mobile telecommunications services supplied, or proposed to be supplied, by the carriers and providers: (a) the reliability of a mobile telecommunications service; (b) the quality of voice calls made and received using a mobile telecommunications service; (c) the performance of a mobile telecommunications service that is a short message service; (d) the maximum period within which a carrier or carriage service provider must rectify a fault or service difficulty relating to a mobile telecommunications service following the making of a report by a customer about the fault or service difficulty;

reach.condition: if it supplies mobile telecommunications services covered by a standard under s 125B
